intro: Torwa Pathfinder is a lone tauren hunter and tracker camped at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater, just below the ramp descending from Tanaris. He observes the basin's primordial wildlife, studying the dangerous predators that rule the jungle floor. Adventurers seeking to test their mettle against the crater's legendary beasts often seek his guidance.

p: Perched at the eastern base of the crater where the desert sands of Tanaris give way to humid jungle steam, Torwa Pathfinder serves as an informal warden for newcomers. He respects the wild forces of Un'Goro, understanding that careless wanderers quickly become fodder for the local fauna. His campsite provides a rare moment of respite before travelers dive into the sweltering depths.

Much of Torwa's attention is consumed by Lar'korwi, a notoriously cunning and fierce raptor roaming the northern reaches of the crater. Torwa understands that brute strength alone cannot bring down such an apex predator. Instead, he instructs hunters to study its feeding habits, using fresh carcase meat and glands to craft a bait potent enough to lure the beast out into the open.

Beyond hunting the crater's apex raptors, Torwa maintains a deep curiosity regarding the toxic flora and aggressive ape colonies that inhabit the basin. He directs travelers to harvest venom from volatile bloodpetals and observe the strength of dominant beasts like the mighty gorilla U'cha, constantly analyzing how nature's deadliest adaptations function in isolation.
